channel.title: TechStack Lab — new and updated guides
channel.description: Source-checked guides on enterprise cloud, security, DevOps, SaaS and AI workflows, including every revision to existing guides.

item.title: New: The real cost of multi-cloud: egress, identity sprawl, and the ops tax nobody budgets for
item.description: A cost model for egress, duplicated security tooling, fragmented discounts and the people needed to run several control planes.

item.title: New: Terraform state at scale: remote backends, locking, and drift detection
item.description: Splitting state by blast radius, S3 native lockfile locking, migrating off DynamoDB, and catching drift in CI.

item.title: New: SSO tax, SCIM, and audit logs: the SaaS procurement checklist for security teams
item.description: Twelve questions to settle before you sign, and which ones vendors quietly reserve for their enterprise tier.

item.title: New: Platform engineering vs. DevOps: what internal developer platforms actually change
item.description: Golden paths, the CNCF maturity model, and the org chart questions to answer before buying a developer portal.

item.title: New: Passkeys in the enterprise: rollout lessons for workforce identity
item.description: Synced vs device-bound passkeys, what NIST SP 800-63B-4 allows, recovery flows, and retiring SMS codes without flooding the help desk.

item.title: New: Kubernetes cost allocation: building a showback model finance will trust
item.description: Requests vs usage, idle capacity and shared services: a defensible method for splitting cluster spend across teams, with a worked example.

item.title: New: Evaluating RAG pipelines for internal knowledge bases: a practical scorecard
item.description: Retrieval precision, groundedness, permissions and freshness: how to score an internal assistant before employees stop trusting it.

item.title: New: Azure landing zones explained: management groups, policy, and subscription vending
item.description: The reference management group hierarchy, where to assign policy and access, and how subscription vending works.

item.title: New: Agentic workflows in ITSM: where automation helps and where it needs a human
item.description: Ticket triage, runbook execution and change approvals, mapped to an autonomy level you can defend in an audit.

item.title: Updated: Zero Trust on AWS: replacing your VPN with identity-aware access
item.description: Corrected the Cedar examples: group membership uses .contains(), not has.

item.title: New: Zero Trust on AWS: replacing your VPN with identity-aware access
item.description: A phased migration plan using AWS Verified Access, your identity provider and device posture signals, without a big-bang cutover.
